'''Greg West''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished Top 2 (qualified) at [[August 1999 Bristol tournament]] on 22 August 1999 with [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]] and T-16 deck, according to Andy Klema's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d17">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-23-bristol-connecticut-8-22-99d17/ bristol-connecticut-8-22-99], DeckTech (Andy "RexBanner7" Klema, 23 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-23-bristol-connecticut-8-22-99d17/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
